[[:File:Ranger's Construct.jpg|View image with boss aura]] | type = Shiro'ken | affiliation = Shiro's army | profession = Ranger | level = 24 (30) | boss = y | campaign = Factions | map1 = [[File:Ranger's Construct map.jpg|150px]] | map1-text= Location in the [[Sunjiang District (explorable area)|Sunjiang District explorable area]] | map2 = [[File:Ranger's Construct map2.jpg|150px]] | map2-text= Alternate route, entering from [[Pongmei Valley]] }} [[Ranger's Construct]] is a [[Ranger]] [[boss]] that can be found in both the [[Sunjiang District]] [[mission]] and [[explorable area]]. == Locations == * [[Kaineng City]] ** {{NPC location|Sunjiang District|explorable area}} (not during [[Redemption for the Lost]]) == Missions == * Kaineng City ** {{NPC location|Sunjiang District}} (shares a [[spawn]] point with [[Mesmer's Construct]]) ==Skills== 15 [[Wilderness Survival]], 20 [[Expertise]] * {{Skill icon|Distracting Shot}} * {{Skill icon|Equinox}} ([[elite]]) * {{Skill icon|Kindle Arrows}} * {{Skill icon|Throw Dirt}} * {{Skill icon|Troll Unguent}} * {{Monster skill icon|Song of the Mists}} == Items dropped == * [[Kaolin Longbow]] ([[unique]]) * [[Soul Stone]] == Notes == * Players can capture Equinox from this boss prior to completing the Sunjiang District mission by waiting at the gate in the south west for it to patrol into flatbow range and pulling it. * Rangers planning to capture Equinox might wish to equip two Signet of Capture to obtain [[Broad Head Arrow]] from [[The Afflicted Huan (ranger)]] who is on the way.
